offers_products.reason: Manufactures pumps, valves, connectors, brake pads, energy absorption components, and actuators across Flow, Motion, and Connect & Control segments.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is mainly engineered components; aftermarket support and repair are secondary to the manufactured products.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells components to industrial, automotive, aerospace, and energy customers; no direct household buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are manufacturers, automakers, rail operators, defense contractors, and oil and gas and chemical companies.

recurring_revenue.reason: Components such as brake pads, connectors, and pump parts are repeat-ordered by OEMs and industrial customers, with aftermarket sales.

cyclical_demand.reason: Industrial, automotive, and energy capital and production demand falls in downturns, though aftermarket is steadier.

big_ticket.reason: Mostly components such as pumps, valves, connectors, and brake pads bought repeatedly; large pump projects are the exception.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured, engineered components, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are automakers, defense contractors, aerospace firms, and large chemical and energy companies.

asset_heavy.reason: Global manufacturing plants for pumps, valves, brake components, and connectors need ongoing capital investment.
